stages.description: Underground cybersecurity training arena inside a server room, seen from slightly above: tall server racks on the far left and far right with small blinking blue and green status lights, a large wall screen in the back center showing abstract green code lines and a simple padlock shield symbol, cable trays along the ceiling, soft blue ceiling lights. A wide dark metal grate floor fills the whole lower half of the image with subtle cyan floor light strips and faint perspective lines, calm and empty so text panels can sit on top of it. Side-view 2D fighting game stage background. Chunky clean pixel art matching simple 64px browser fighting game characters, limited palette, dark navy and deep blue base with cyan and teal accents. No people, no characters, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI.

stages.description: Fighting game versus screen backdrop inside cyberspace: a glowing digital data tunnel with circuit board lines and streams of tiny pixel data blocks rushing toward a bright vanishing point in the center. The left half is lit in cool electric blue, the right half in warm orange, split by a jagged diagonal lightning seam of white and cyan energy running from the top right to the bottom left. Dark navy base, chunky clean pixel art, limited palette, strong contrast, dramatic and energetic. The left third and right third stay calmer for character cards. No people, no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI.
